Title: How to Store Vinyl Records: 7 Steps to Stop Warping
Description: How to store vinyl records so they never warp: stand them upright with full-height dividers, swap paper inner sleeves for poly ones, take off the shrink wrap and keep them cool, dark and dry. Plus how much a full shelf of LPs really weighs.
Keywords: how to store vinyl records, vinyl record storage, record storage ideas

Title: Vinyl Record Storage Tips: Upright, Cool and Dry
Description: Vinyl record storage tips from the Library of Congress and the National Archives: about 65 to 70°F and 45 to 50% humidity, dividers every 4 to 6 inches, no attics or garages, and a shelf rated for the weight (35 to 45 lb per shelf-foot).
Keywords: vinyl storage, record collection storage, IKEA KALLAX records
